Four new fighters are now available in Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons! 

Joining the fight are Armor Okada, Jackson, Jim Mackey and fan favorite Bimmy!

With roguelite elements, every playthrough is a chance at new action. Play as one of 24 characters, each with their own special moves and playstyles. 

Purchase today on Xbox!
